caption: The drawing depicts a two-pan balance scale hanging from a central vertical rod. The scale consists of a horizontal beam, shown in a brownish-gray color, with a hook at the top for hanging and a pointer at the center. At each end of the beam, there is a round, shallow pan colored in a brownish-copper tone, and each pan is suspended by three thin wires or cords attached to small hooks. There is a small weight hanging from the center of the beam beneath the pointer. The background is a plain, off-white or beige color, and there is some faint text on the drawing near the right pan and at the bottom right corner. The objects are drawn with fine detail and are centered in the composition, with ample empty space surrounding them.
title: Balance Scales
